def fetch_page_metadata(page_url: str) -> dict:
    """
    Fetches the title and description metadata from the specified web page URL.

    Args:
        page_url: A valid URL pointing to a public web page. Example: 'https://example.com/article'

    Returns:
        A dictionary containing the page's title and description, e.g.:
        {'title': 'Example', 'description': 'An example page'}

        If the page cannot be fetched or parsed, default fallback values are returned.
    """
    try:
        # Fetch the content of the specified URL with improved SSL context
        context = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())
        with urllib.request.urlopen(page_url, context=context) as response:
            content = response.read().decode('utf-8')

        # Extract title
        title_match = re.search(r'<title>(.*?)</title>', content, re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
        title = title_match.group(1).strip() if title_match else "No title found"

        # Extract meta description – robust approach:
        # 1. Find the whole <meta ...> tag that contains name="description"
        meta_tag_match = re.search(
            r'<meta[^>]*\bname\s*=\s*["\']description["\'][^>]*>',
            content,
            re.IGNORECASE
        )
        description = "No description available"
        if meta_tag_match:
            meta_tag = meta_tag_match.group(0)
            # 2. From that tag, extract the content attribute value
            content_match = re.search(
                r'\bcontent\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']*)["\']',
                meta_tag,
                re.IGNORECASE
            )
            if content_match:
                description = content_match.group(1).strip()

        return {
            'title': title,
            'description': description
        }

    except (urllib.error.URLError, urllib.error.HTTPError,
            ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        # If the page cannot be fetched or parsed, return default values
        return {
            'title': 'Content unavailable',
            'description': 'Unable to fetch page content'
        }

    """Extract <title> and <meta name="description"> content from HTML."""

        super().__init__()
        self.title: str = ""
        self.description: str = ""
        self._in_title: bool = False
        self._title_data: list = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list):

            self._title_data.clear()

        if tag == "title" and self._in_title:

            self.title = "".join(self._title_data).strip()

    def handle_data(self, data: str):

def fetch_page_metadata(page_url: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """

    Args:
        page_url: A valid URL pointing to a public webpage.

    Returns:
        A dictionary with keys 'title' and 'description'.

            charset = "utf-8"

            raw_html = response.read()

        parser.feed(html)
        parser.close()

        result["title"] = parser.title
        result["description"] = parser.description

    except (urllib.error.URLError, urllib.error.HTTPError, OSError, ValueError):
        # Any network or URL problem results in an empty result
        pass

    return result
